# Calendar fixtures

`three-events.ics` is a small iCalendar file (RFC 5545) for the calendar connector (E18-02): a visit to Dr Tan (with an organiser, an attendee, a folded description and an alarm, none of which may be kept), a dialysis session at a hospital written by its initials, and a lunch with a friend that is not a visit and must not be stored anywhere. The names and addresses are invented; the dates are after the tests' frozen clock (3 September 2026).
